title: Grinning Face
description: A yellow face with simple, open eyes and a broad, open smile, showing upper teeth and tongue on some platforms. Often conveys general pleasure and good cheer or humor.

title: Face with Tears of Joy
description: A yellow face with a big grin, uplifted eyebrows, and smiling eyes, each shedding a tear from laughing so hard. Widely used to show something is funny or pleasing.

title: Red Heart
description: A classic love heart emoji, used for expressions of love. Displayed in various shades of red on most platforms.

title: Thumbs Up
description: A thumbs-up gesture indicating approval. Commonly used to express agreement or acceptance.

title: Fire
description: A flame, as produced when something is on fire. Depicted as a red, orange, and yellow flickering flame.

title: Smiling Face with Heart-Eyes
description: A yellow face with smiling eyes, a closed smile, rosy cheeks, and several hearts floating around its head. Expresses a range of positive, happy, and affectionate feelings, especially being in love.

title: Winking Face
description: A yellow face with a slight smile shown winking, usually its left eye. May signal a joke, flirtation, hidden meaning, or general positivity.

title: OK Hand
description: A gesture showing the index finger and thumb touching to make an open circle. Represents 'okay', 'all good', or 'very good'. May signal approval, agreement, consent, or comfort.

title: Sunflower
description: A sunflower, a tall, round flower with large yellow petals. Depicted as a single, vertical sunflower with a large, dark-brown center on a green stem.

title: Smirking Face
description: A yellow face with a sly, smug, mischievous, or suggestive facial expression. Often used to convey flirtation or sexual innuendo.

title: Crying Face
description: A yellow face with a big tear falling from one eye, usually depicted as closed eyes with an open mouth.

title: Loudly Crying Face
description: A yellow face with an open mouth wailing and streams of heavy tears flowing from closed eyes.

title: Angry Face
description: A yellow face with a frowning mouth and eyes and eyebrows scrunched downward in anger. Google's design features a reddish face and Facebook's, clenched teeth.

title: Sleeping Face
description: A yellow face with eyes closed and mouth letting out three, cartoon-styled Zzz’s overhead to indicate it's sound asleep.

title: Thinking Face
description: A yellow face with furrowed eyebrows looking upwards with thumb and index finger resting on its chin. Used to indicate thinking, or deep thought.

title: Penguin
description: A penguin, a flightless bird adapted to water and ice. Depicted as a black-and-white bird with a yellow or orange beak.

title: Tropical Drink
description: A tropical drink, served with a straw and wedge of lemon or lime. Positioned at a 45° angle, with a cherry on top.

title: Football
description: A round, black and white ball used in the game of football, which is known as soccer in much of the world.

title: Graduation Cap
description: A graduation cap, worn on the head of students graduating from college or university. Known as a mortarboard in the United States.

title: Rocket
description: A rocket being propelled into space. Shown either leaving a trail of exhaust gases and flames or as already in space.

title: Unicorn Face
description: The face of a unicorn, a mythical creature in the form of a white horse with a single, long horn on its forehead. Generally depicted as a white horse head facing left with a pink or purple mane and a yellow or rainbow-colored horn.

title: Blue Heart
description: A blue heart emoji, commonly used to represent love and affection. Displayed in various shades of blue on most platforms.

title: Money Bag
description: A bag full of money. Depicted as a sack, usually tan, tied off and displaying a dollar sign.

title: Bicycle
description: A classic two-wheeled bicycle, which is used for exercise, sport, or transportation.

title: Movie Camera
description: A classic movie camera, as used to shoot film or movies. Generally depicted as a gray or black video camera with viewfinder, control buttons, and lens pointed left.

title: Hamburger
description: A hamburger, beef burger, burger, or cheeseburger with two buns and a beef patty, displayed with cheese, lettuce, and tomato, or additional toppings on most platforms.

title: House with Garden
description: A two-story house, with a display of greenery in front, or a garden. Commonly used for various content concerning building and houses, or residential areas in general.

title: Airplane
description: A commercial airliner, as flown by a pilot. Depicted with two or three sections of windows, mounted on a landing gear, and pointed left or right.

title: Basketball
description: A basketball, used in the sport of basketball, which is played on a court with two hoops. Depicted as an orange or brown ball with textured surface.

title: Globe Showing Americas
description: A globe, showing the continents of North and South America in green against blue ocean. May be used to represent various content concerning the North and South American regions.

title: Alarm Clock
description: An old-fashioned alarm clock, mechanical, with two bells on top. In the past, often set to 07:00 in the morning.

title: Candle
description: A burning candle, as lit when taking a bath or the power is out. Depicted as a white, pillar-shaped candle with a flame and wax dripping down its side.

title: Fishing Pole
description: A fishing rod (pole) with a fishing line and a fish hooked at the end. May be used to represent various types of fishing activities.

title: Laptop Computer
description: A personal computer, most commonly depicted as a laptop computer. May be used for various content concerning computers, technology, and work.

title: Soccer Ball
description: A round, black and white ball used in the game of football, which is known as soccer in much of the world.

title: Sun with Face
description: The sun, with a face. Often depicted with a smiling face, with sunglasses, or with a sunburst of rays.

title: Telephone
description: A classic telephone, as a landline home phone. Most platforms depict a red, push-button phone with the handset on the base.

title: Beach with Umbrella
description: A tropical beach with a palm tree, beach umbrella, and beach ball. May be used to represent various types of beaches (e.g., tropical, sandy, pebble) and summer fun.

title: Guitar
description: A guitar, a stringed musical instrument with a wooden body and a fretted neck. Played by strumming or plucking the strings with one hand while fretting the strings with the other hand.

title: Cat Face
description: The face of a cat, looking directly forward. Shown as yellow or gray on most platforms, this emoji generally has a cartoon-style appearance and visible whiskers.

title: Car
description: A car, which is generally depicted as a red or blue sedan, styled after various notable car manufacturers.

title: Rainbow
description: A rainbow with six colors: violet, blue, green, yellow, orange, red. Apple and WhatsApp's designs feature pots of gold at each end of the rainbow.

title: Penguin
description: A penguin, a flightless bird adapted to water and ice. Depicted as a black-and-white bird with a yellow or orange beak.

title: Cocktail Glass
description: A glass filled with a cocktail, usually containing ice, alcohol, and a garnish—such as a lemon or lime slice. Positioned at a 45° angle, as if about to slide into the glass.

title: Shopping Bags
description: Two colorful shopping bags, as contain consumer items purchased at a department store. Depicted as gift bags in various bright colors, patterns, and sizes.

title: Globe Showing Europe-Africa
description: A globe, showing the continents of Europe and Africa in green against blue ocean. May be used to represent various content concerning the European and African regions.

title: Horse
description: The face of a horse, looking straight ahead. Generally depicted in full profile on all fours facing left, with a flowing mane and tail.

title: Taco
description: A taco, a traditional Mexican dish, displayed inside a hard or soft taco shell. Ingredients vary by platform, most commonly including beef, lettuce, and cheese.

title: Motorcycle
description: A motorcycle, otherwise known as a motorbike used for sport/racing or for transportation. Depicted as a sport bike in Apple's artwork, and a cruiser motorcycle in Google's.

title: Game Die
description: A six-sided die, used in a range of board and turn-based games. Commonly called 'dice' or 'd6' in role-playing games.

title: Television
description: A classic television set, as CRT-based TV (cathode ray tube) with rabbit-ear antennas. Commonly used for various content concerning television, broadcasting, and watching TV.
